yt.title: Astronauts see {c_n16} sunrises a day #Shorts
yt.description:
ISS at ~420 km altitude: orbital period from Kepler's third law (GM of Earth), ~93 minutes; ~15.5 orbits per day.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.narration: Astronauts on the space station see about sixteen sunrises every day.
It flies four hundred twenty kilometers up, at {c_kmh_say} kilometers per hour. One lap takes {c_min_say} minutes.

scenes.label: sunrises and sunsets
scenes.narration: That's {c_n_say} laps a day. A sunrise every lap.
So they keep a strict clock, and cover the windows to sleep.
